answers.reason: Names the exact external break: react-native-web@0.21.3 (published 2026-09-25T15:00Z, after ORI-RN-003's committed green) dies inside uniwind 1.11.0's incomplete package.json exports map during expo export --platform web ('Unable to resolve module ./exports/InputAccessoryView'); reproduced standalone twice; pinning 0.21.2 in the same consumer exports cleanly; the fix is a one-line pin in packages/docs-snippets/{nativewind,uniwind}/package.json.
Not a reviewer finding; an implementer blocked report naming an upstream dependency release breaking fresh installs.
